name: makerline
description: MakerLine — know if it's worth building, then build it right. Open-source Claude plugins by Sairam Mogullapalli.

plugins.name: makerline
plugins.description: MakerLine turns a product idea into an honest verdict, real competitors, wireframes and a draft PRD. Once you approve, it helps you build and ship the product, with WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, security and tests enforced at every step.

plugins.name: makerline-idea
plugins.description: MakerLine Idea turns a product idea into an honest evaluation: a verdict, real competitors with a differentiator test, the strongest version of the idea, an accessibility and compliance check, clickable wireframes, a draft PRD and a one-page summary. No code; you decide go, change or stop.
